Currently in beta, food ai is not fully implemented.

What this means, is that your squad will not get food on their own, you have to micro manage this into their inventory. For small squads, this is not hard, but for larger player factions with multiple squads this can be a problem.

One solution is a provisioner.

Consider the provisioner to be the guy you put in charge of the rations. I recommend either a skeleton or one someone who is a "bone person", as skeletons do not eat, and bone people do not eat as much.

the provisoner will carry enough rations for the squad, and when members run out, they can get more from the provisoner. Keep them close to where each squad is working.

It gets very helpful if this member is also cooking.

You should be cooking your food once a farm is ready, cooking greenfriuit into cooked vegetables more than doubles its nutritional value or NU in the game.

But what if you are poor, and you do not have money for a farm?

Mine iron near the towns. One stack of iron ore is more than enough to get food for a 10 man squad. There are plenty of iron resources near the towns that you can mine at will. For the rock bottom start(where you start in the middle of the desert, naked and severely beaten) this is a great way to get established.

You do not want anyone to hit starvation. once they hit half a bar in starvation, they will pass out. the debuffs from hunger are very bad by themselves, but starvation is much worse.
How to survive in beta: Food.
